overview: Zoom uses OAuth 2.0. You create a Zoom OAuth app in the Zoom Marketplace, receive a Client ID and Client Secret, and redirect users through Zoom's authorisation flow. Zoom issues a scoped access token on completion.

oauth_client_id.label: Client ID
oauth_client_id.description: Found on your app's credentials page in the Zoom Marketplace App Dashboard.

oauth_client_secret.label: Client Secret
oauth_client_secret.description: Found alongside the Client ID. Keep it confidential — it authenticates server-side calls.

steps.title: Open Zoom Marketplace
steps.description: Go to marketplace.zoom.us and sign in with your Zoom account.

steps.title: Create an OAuth app
steps.description: Click 'Build App' → 'OAuth'. Choose 'User-managed app' for end-user authorisation. Enter the app name and whether it is intended for account-level or user-level access.
steps.tip: Choose 'User-managed' for integrations where individual users grant access to their Zoom accounts.

steps.title: Set the redirect URL
steps.description: In the app's 'App Credentials' section, add the Nolixan callback URL as an OAuth Redirect URL.
steps.warning: The redirect URL must match exactly. Zoom returns an error if it does not match.

steps.title: Add scopes
steps.description: Go to 'Scopes' and add the required permissions: meeting:read, meeting:write, user:read, recording:read.
steps.tip: Request only the scopes your integration needs. Users see these during authorisation.

steps.title: Copy Client ID and Client Secret
steps.description: From the 'App Credentials' page, copy the Client ID and Client Secret.
steps.warning: Never expose the Client Secret in client-side code.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: In Nolixan, create the integration with the Client ID and Client Secret. Initiate the OAuth flow for each user.

tips: Zoom access tokens expire after 1 hour — Nolixan auto-refreshes them using the refresh token.
Zoom requires app review/approval before you can use the app with users outside your account.
For internal tools (only your own account), you can use a Server-to-Server OAuth app instead.
warnings: Zoom apps require approval before being available to other Zoom users — plan for the review process.
Never expose the Client Secret. Rotate it immediately if compromised via Zoom Marketplace → App Credentials.
